mapper.select: SELECT id, company_id AS companyId, title, content, included_indicators::text AS includedIndicators, layout_settings::text AS layoutSettings, created_at AS createdAt FROM report_templates WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, company_id AS companyId, title, content, included_indicators::text AS includedIndicators, layout_settings::text AS layoutSettings, created_at AS createdAt FROM report_templates ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT id, company_id AS companyId, template_id AS templateId, target_year AS targetYear, scope, title, content, version, file_url AS fileUrl, is_public AS isPublic, generated_by AS generatedBy, created_at AS createdAt FROM generated_reports WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, company_id AS companyId, template_id AS templateId, target_year AS targetYear, scope, title, content, version, file_url AS fileUrl, is_public AS isPublic, generated_by AS generatedBy, created_at AS createdAt FROM generated_reports WHERE company_id = #{companyId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT facility_name FROM company_facilities WHERE company_id = #{companyId} ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT m.id, i.indicator_code AS indicatorCode, i.title AS title, i.category::text AS category, i.unit AS unit, m.period_value AS periodValue, m.numerical_value AS numericalValue, m.status::text AS status, m.reporting_year AS reportingYear, f.facility_name AS facilityName, m.additional_info::text AS additionalInfo FROM esg_metric_data m JOIN esg_indicators i ON m.indicator_id = i.id LEFT JOIN company_facilities f ON m.facility_id = f.id WHERE m.company_id = #{companyId} AND m.reporting_year = #{year} AND m.status = 'APPROVED' ORDER BY m.period_value ASC, f.id ASC
